title: Decoding an encoded machine
statement: Let $c$ be a machine code with an encoder and decoder satisfying the padding property that decoding the encoding of any machine followed by any number of true bits returns that machine. For every machine $M$, decoding its encoding returns $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A code with encode and decode maps satisfying the stated padding property
